payload.core_composition_summary: Sort distinct values, then use greedy two-pointers to progressively shrink max-min range by merging the end with smaller adjustment cost.
payload.rationale: Sorting organizes values; the two-pointer greedy loop uses sorted order to decide which end to shrink, coordinating both mechanisms.
